title: Screen-Before-Bed Overage by App Category
dataSources: Alcohol habit events (`habit:alcohol`), caffeine intake (`habit:caffeine`), screen-time sessions (`habit:screen`), and fasting windows (`habit:fasting`).
app: Habit-boundary telemetry for Dry January, caffeine cutoffs, screen-before-bed limits, and fasting windows sent to Splunk HEC via apps, shortcuts, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=habit:screen
| search bed_window=true overage_min>0
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(overage_min) as overage_min by _time app_category
| sort - _time
description: Tracks screen-before-bed overage over time and breaks it out by app category.
value: App-category overage tells you whether the last-hour leak is mainly social, video, or gaming.
implementation: Send screen-before-bed overage events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of screen-before-bed overage by app category.
detailedImplementation:
## Prerequisites

• **Splunk**: Splunk Enterprise ≥9.0 or Splunk Cloud — a single-instance home lab is fine. Create `index=personal` with 90–365 day retention (`indexes.conf`).
• **HEC token**: Settings → Data Inputs → HTTP Event Collector → New Token → index `personal`. Store the token in your connector's environment (never commit it to git).
• **Upstream product**: Personal HEC index — HTTP Event Collector token on index=personal.
• **Subcategory context**: Everyday Habits & Vices — typical feeds: Alcohol drinks (`alcohol:drink`), vice logs (`vice:log`), hydration intake (`hydration:intake`), swear-jar entries (`swearjar:entry`)..
• **Sourcetypes in this search**: `habit:screen`.
• **Network**: The connector host must reach both the vendor API/MQTT broker and your Splunk HEC port (8088/tcp).

## Step 1 — Configure data collection

Route **Personal HEC index** events into `index=personal` with `sourcetype=habit:screen`.

**Collection method:** HTTP Event Collector token on index=personal.

**Reference endpoint / path:** `POST https://<splunk>:8088/services/collector/event`.

**Suggested poll interval:** depends on upstream connector.

**Key fields to extract:** `sourcetype-specific — see search filters`.

**Typical connector stack:** Habit and sobriety trackers, alcohol-unit and hydration logs, vaping/smoking cessation apps, and a smart swear jar — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT..

**Author notes:** Send screen-before-bed overage events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.


Example HEC payload shape:

```json
{"index": "personal", "sourcetype": "habit:screen", "event": { ... vendor fields ... }}
```

Verify ingestion with:

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=habit:screen earliest=-24h | head 20
```

## Step 2 — Create the search and alert

This search implements **Screen-Before-Bed Overage by App Category** over `personal` data (primarily `sourcetype=habit:screen`) across the full search range. It applies numeric thresholds on `overage_min` (> 0) after sum — tune these constants to your household baseline.

**Fields this search depends on:** `_time`, `app_category`, `overage_min`. Confirm each is populated before scheduling alerts.

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=habit:screen
| search bed_window=true overage_min>0
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(overage_min) as overage_min by _time app_category
| sort - _time
```

## Step 3 — Validate

**(a) Compare to vendor UI:** Splunk Search → index=personal | stats count by sourcetype. Totals for the same day/week should match within connector lag (usually one poll interval).

**(b) Field presence:**

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=habit:screen earliest=-7d
| head 50
| table _time, app_category, overage_min
```

Every column the detection uses should be non-null on recent rows.

**(c) Volume sanity:**

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=habit:screen earliest=-30d
| timechart span=1d count
```

Flatlines usually mean a broken token, expired OAuth refresh, or HEC URL change.

**(d) Threshold calibration:** Profile `overage_min` before alerting:

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=habit:screen earliest=-30d
| stats perc50(overage_min) AS p50 perc90(overage_min) AS p90 perc99(overage_min) AS p99 max(overage_min) AS hi
```

## Step 4 — Operationalize

Create a companion dashboard titled `UC-25.33.23: Personal evidence` with the following panel layout:

**Panel 1 — Stacked Time Chart Of Screen-Before-Bed Overage By App Category (the key fields):** Configure according to standard Splunk visualization patterns for this panel type.


Time picker defaults: set to last 30 days with named presets for 24h, 7d, 30d, 90d, and 1y — the auditor needs all five windows without retyping. Enable scheduled PDF export for the full dashboard on the regulation's reporting cadence.

## Step 5 — Troubleshooting

**Personal HEC index — no Personal HEC index events / missing fields:** If `habit:screen` stops updating, re-check HEC token, index `personal`, and firewall to port 8088. Search `index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd group=http_event_collector` for rejection reasons. Confirm the Personal HEC index connector script is still running (`systemctl status` or cron log).

**Personal HEC index — NULL values in extracted fields:** The Personal HEC index JSON export shape drifted — compare a raw event (`index=personal sourcetype=habit:screen | head 1 | spath`) against the field names in Step 2. Re-map in the connector before changing the SPL.

**Personal HEC index — API error / auth denied (401/403):** Refresh tokens expire on most consumer APIs — re-authorize the scripted input, update `passwords.conf` / env vars, and verify the vendor developer app is not in sandbox mode.

**Personal HEC index — endpoint timeout / HTTP 429 throttling:** Back off the poll interval in the connector; Personal HEC index APIs often cap requests per 15 minutes on free tiers.

**Bucket misalignment:** `span=1d` buckets on UTC by default — if your routine is local-time based, add `| eval _time=_time + (local_offset)` or use `@d` / `@w` snap.

**Stale dashboard:** Confirm the saved search `dispatch.earliest_time` covers enough history for your `1d` buckets.
grandmaExplanation: It totals how screen-before-bed overage changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
